basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Physics at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Project Assistant - Technical post on the project "Development of Cost Effective Aluminium Ion Batteries Using Indigenous Materials", funded by DFTM, DRDO, Ministry of Defence. The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 27,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, with HRA as applicable. The tenure is 36 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. No application fee is charged (Rs. 0 for all categories), and the last date to apply is 22 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications online and fixes 22 November 2026 as the last date. It does not print the web address of the online form. The application fee is Rs. 0 for every category, but the notice says transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form. It also names the following account for fee deposit through RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc.:
Bank name: State Bank of India (00202)
Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302
Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints two routes for the essential qualification. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum. Candidates from Engineering/Physics/Materials Science/Energy Sciences/Chemical Engineering/ECE would be preferred. The candidate should have basic computer proficiency and be able to handle Word and Excel software. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Technical Diploma (3 years duration) / Graduate Degree in appropriate discipline with 3 years relevant work experience in relevant field. OR ITI (2 years duration) in relevant trade with 8 years relevant work experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 27,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice adds "HRA as applicable". The tenure is 36 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is described as temporary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications online and fixes 22 November 2026 as the last date. It does not print the web address of the online form. The application fee is Rs. 0 for every category, but the notice says transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form. It also names the following account for fee deposit through RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc.: Bank name: State Bank of India (00202) Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302 Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account Account No.: 39502115210 IFSC Code: SBIN0000202 SWIFT Code: SBININBB339

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and that mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant - Technical post in the Department of Physics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Technical Diploma (3 years duration) or Graduate Degree in appropriate discipline with 3 years relevant work experience in relevant field, or an ITI (2 years duration) in relevant trade with 8 years relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Assistant - Technical?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 27,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. HRA is as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. Transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project. The tenure is 36 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which agency is funding the project?
faq.answer: The sponsoring agency is the Directorate of Futuristic Technology Management (DFTM), Defence Research and Development Organisation, Ministry of Defence.

faq.question: Q10. Does holding the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says mere possession of the prescribed qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
